question: 在同日同母体下，扩散与估值历史代理是否改善简单价格排序？
scope: SW2014/SW2021 L2/L3 separately; all available industries, no EP34 pool restriction; L1 basket pending

hypotheses.F: 信息缓慢扩散使相对动量延续；未来相对收益无正向排序为反证
hypotheses.H: 更广泛上涨支持持续性，极端交易活跃可能增加脆弱性；必须分开比较扩散与交易拥挤
hypotheses.G: 低历史PE分位降低定价要求；盈利衰退与PE修订可能使低分位无效

transforms: within era/level/date average-tie centered rank: (rank-0.5)/n-0.5; no future values, no missing imputation

scores.C: -rank(turn_rank504); transaction proxy only, no holdings crowding claim
scores.G: -rank(pe_rank504); median constituent positive TTM-PE historical rank, NOT forward PE

comparisons: F full coverage vs momentum; paired F/FD, F/FC, F/FG, F/FDG on exact common feature-ready origin sets, report matched denominator loss separately
target: NAV(t+1+h)/NAV(t+1)-1 minus CSI_ALL same-period close return; require full continuous industry block throughout entry and target
evaluation: date-level Spearman IC, top quintile/bottom quintile excess returns, annual/era/level stability; no outcome-dependent membership ranking
missing_outcomes: retain feature-based ranks and selections; report missing outcomes; do not replace selected industries or fill missing returns with zero; suppress group return if any selected outcome missing
uncertainty: paired date-level IC differences; circular 6-month block bootstrap, 2000 replications, seed 3501; Bonferroni across 4 extensions x 2 levels x 2 eras =16 primary tests; secondary horizon descriptive
acceptance: positive delta IC with multiplicity-adjusted interval above zero, at least 24 paired months, positive delta in >=2/3 eligible calendar years; otherwise evidence insufficient/no stable increment. No prediction capability declaration from historical proxy alone.
costs: 0,20,50 bps per side; fixed-horizon top-quintile diagnostic assumes full entry/exit, reports return minus 2*cost; not compounded, not implementable portfolio or turnover estimate
split: R01 untrained fixed rules all dates historical simulation, yearly and classification-era separate; supervised models registered separately before fitting
limitations: equal-weight synthetic research baskets not published industry indices or tradable holdings
PE missing known_at; historical proxy only
original Founders full definitions unavailable; public URL fetch timed out 2026-11-13; not a replication
next_dependency: three-task supervised baselines, local financial timing audit, L1 construction, mechanism data audit, portfolio replay
